source: day 2: a proposed Slack reply to a stakeholder's question awaited my approval; the reply itself asked them back how instalments are invoiced. Once sent, nothing recorded that we now waited for them, and their answer would have arrived as a new, unrelated mention. Replayed with outreach on the mention: the reply is the outreach's message, their thread answer is matched to it, and with no repo session holding the mention the answer is surfaced to me.
setup: bosun ledger upsert 'slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033' --kind mention --title 'Marco: instalment plans need backend support'

steps.why: the reply asks something back, so it is outreach on the mention
steps.run: bosun ledger ask 'slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033' --to 'Marco Rossi' --purpose clarification --question 'For instalment plans: one invoice per instalment, or one invoice with a payment schedule?'

steps.why: the exact reply, for my approval
steps.run: bosun ledger propose 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033/1' 'Slack reply in the thread: The backend can support instalment plans. Open question: one invoice per instalment, or one invoice with a payment schedule?'

steps.why: a habit from other proposals: resolve done is refused with the right command
out: record it with bosun ledger sent

steps.why: the mention is answered but waits on Marco, so it stays open
out: is waiting on: out:slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033/1 (slack to Marco Rossi,

steps.why: his answer in the thread is matched, not a new mention
out: in the conversation of out:slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033/1 (clarification to Marco Rossi

steps.why: recorded; no window holds the mention, so it goes to me
run: bosun ledger replied 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033/1' --evidence "$R" --summary 'one invoice with a schedule'
out: slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033 is not with a repo session; tell me the reply

steps.why: handing it to a window is refused, with the way out
surfaced in the plan, then applied
steps.run: bosun ledger transition 'out:slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033/1' applied --note 'surfaced to the user'

steps.why: the reply is a processed outreach source

steps.run: bosun ledger transition 'slack:C0000000003/1700000033.000033' done --note 'answered; Marco clarified'
